purpose: Evaluate deployment, runtime identity, smoke/health, observability, recovery and post-deploy evidence without embedding provider-specific hosting instructions.
activate_when: A mission claims that a web product or service has been deployed to preview, staging or production.
A release claim depends on proving that the deployed runtime is healthy, observable and recoverable after deployment.

evidence: Deployment result, runtime identity and recovery evidence from the resolved hosting surface.
Health, logs/errors or other declared operational signals covering the deployed target.

entry_points.purpose: Evaluate deployment identity, smoke/health, observability, recovery and post-deploy evidence and return PASS, FAIL or INCOMPLETE.

failure_modes: The deployment fails or the running version cannot be proven to match the intended release.
A blocking smoke check or required health check fails.
A required logging/observability signal fails or cannot be obtained.
The selected recovery strategy fails or is absent.
The post-deploy observation window reveals a material operational defect.
recovery_actions: Stop delivery-state progression and preserve the failing operational evidence.
Correct the release or configuration and redeploy the intended artifact.
Restore health/smoke and required observability signals before reevaluation.
Exercise the selected rollback, redeploy-previous or roll-forward path on an authorized surface and recapture evidence.
Repeat post-deploy verification against the corrected running release.
stop_conditions: Required hosting or observability capabilities are unavailable.
The running release identity cannot be established.
A blocking health/smoke defect remains unresolved.
No viable recovery strategy can be demonstrated.
Required post-deploy evidence remains unavailable or inconclusive.
